name: Australia
post_study_work_summary: The Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485), Post-Higher Education Work stream, usually allows graduates to stay between two and three years depending on their qualification. Applicants must generally be aged 35 or under, with exceptions.
indicative_fees_note: Undergraduate AUD 25,000 to 45,000 a year; postgraduate AUD 25,000 to 50,000; average AUD 30,000 to 40,000.

name: Canada
post_study_work_summary: Eligible graduates may apply for a Post-Graduation Work Permit. Master's programmes of at least eight months, and other programmes of two years or more, may lead to a three-year permit. Most applicants have needed language results since 1 November 2024.
indicative_fees_note: Undergraduate CAD 18,000 to 40,000 a year; postgraduate CAD 15,000 to 35,000; average CAD 20,000 to 30,000.

name: Germany
post_study_work_summary: International graduates of German universities may receive a residence permit of up to 18 months to seek qualified employment, during which any type of work is permitted. The permit is not renewable.
indicative_fees_note: Public universities EUR 3,000 to 15,000 a year; private EUR 10,000 to 25,000; average EUR 8,000 to 18,000.

name: United Kingdom
post_study_work_summary: Bachelor's and master's graduates on a Student visa may apply in the UK for the Graduate visa: two years if applying by 31 December 2026, or 18 months if applying on or after 1 January 2027.
indicative_fees_note: Undergraduate GBP 12,000 to 25,000 a year; postgraduate GBP 14,000 to 30,000; average GBP 15,000 to 22,000.

name: New Zealand
post_study_work_summary: Degree graduates (Level 7 or above, 30 weeks' full-time study in New Zealand) may receive a Post-Study Work Visa of up to three years. From 16 November 2026, Level 7 graduate diploma holders with a bachelor's degree also qualify.
indicative_fees_note: Undergraduate NZD 22,000 to 35,000 a year; postgraduate NZD 25,000 to 40,000; average NZD 25,000 to 35,000.

name: United States
post_study_work_summary: F-1 graduates may usually receive up to 12 months of post-completion Optional Practical Training per higher education level. Graduates with qualifying STEM degrees may apply for a further 24-month STEM OPT extension.
indicative_fees_note: Undergraduate USD 20,000 to 50,000 a year; postgraduate USD 18,000 to 45,000; average USD 25,000 to 40,000.
